name: command-bar-native-look
description: With opaqueSurround on, the command bar switches its whole look to the window's native chrome: a neutral plate, the system font, the system selection blue, and no key underline. Same fixture and flow as command-bar-wears-the-space-tint.json, but with a settings fixture that turns opaqueSurround on, read from the live /commandbar document.

actions.note: AC: opaqueSurround pushes the native-chrome class into this document
AC: native mode drops the key underline

assertions.label: the-page-heading-shows-above-the-palette-not-a-white-sheet
assertions.desc: sidebar.css painted the surround on the bare native html class, and this overlay document covers the whole window, so the palette sat on a white sheet with the sidebar and the page gone. This region is the page's 'Example Domain' heading, black text on white. Measured 2026-09-02 on that code: 255. With the surround scoped to the sidebar document: 150. The sidebar column is no use as a gate here, since this fixture's surround is itself white.
